name: get_party_member_character_index

stack.evidence: func_001D59B8 replaces party_slot with D_003010F8->unk_48E[party_slot] when the slot is less than four

notes: D_003010F8+0x48E is the active party-slot character-index array. func_001F0BD8 passes the indexed value to func_0013DA88 to resolve that party member's live object, while func_001EF960 uses it to select the character's game-data record. The JP corpus contains 193 calls.
